items.title: GLabNetOps: Network Operations & Tooling
items.summary: GLabNetOps is the name I use for related network-operations work and smaller tools. This page connects the projects without implying they form one live, integrated platform.

guide.title: How to evaluate the GLabNetOps project track
guide.summary: Read each component on its own terms: check its repository, lifecycle and operating boundary instead of treating GLabNetOps as one deployed product.

items.title: Network Analyzer v2026.08.21
items.summary: A Linux toolkit I’m documenting for authorized wireless observation, saved-scan analysis and reports. Passing software checks is not the same as proving behaviour on every adapter or environment.

guide.title: Authorized operator guide
guide.summary: Use an authorized test setup, start with saved data or passive scans, and check each reported finding against its source evidence before acting on it.

items.title: Noney BSNL Broadband NMS
items.summary: I keep this page as a retrospective on a rural broadband operations system that connected service workflows, network visibility, planning and mapping. The production environment is retired; this is not a live service or redeployment guide.

guide.title: How to read this case study
guide.summary: Use this as a retrospective on the workflow and boundaries. Production has been retired, and the public repository is not the former operational application.

items.title: Rongmei Hymnal
items.summary: I’m building an offline-first reading experience for Rongmei and community song collections. The app and the content need different kinds of review, and editorial checks and attribution remain part of the work.

guide.title: Run, maintain, and review Rongmei Hymnal
guide.summary: Run the app locally if needed, then review text provenance, attribution and community corrections separately from the app’s technical checks.

items.title: SSH Fleet Doctor
items.summary: SSH Fleet Doctor is an in-development remote administration and diagnostics project. The intended workflow is to connect to authorized hosts over SSH, collect system information, detect configured issues, and run reviewed commands or scripts to fix problems—with safety controls and current implementation clearly distinguished from planned work.

guide.title: Set up SSH Fleet Doctor safely
guide.summary: Use one authorized test host. Start with verified SSH host identity and read-only diagnostics; test each remediation command independently with approval, logging, and rollback.

items.title: Network Analyzer v2024.06.24
items.summary: This is the older Bash-based Network Analyzer snapshot. I keep it for historical comparison and code review, not as instructions to run unchanged on a current system.

guide.title: Safe review of the 2024 release
guide.summary: Review the archived Bash code and its environment assumptions as historical material; don’t assume it is suitable to run unmodified today.
